title: Build an owned canonical row with literal address generation
body:
A fixed **3,397-location, fifteen-tape program** emits every bit of a canonical padded-rotation row from four borrowed descriptors. It constructs each wire address on tape, preserves the inputs, clears all private bodies and temporary guards, and returns every head. For `N=2^h`, its complete bounds are **1280N(h+4) transitions** and **N+20(h+4) additional historical cells**. This closes the local owned-row interface left open by [PR #7740](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7740). **No new kappa** or complete CRT caller is claimed.

Read the [proof and full bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/PROOF.md), [fixed graph emitter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/program.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/RESULT.json), [two instruction paths](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/interpreters.py), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/857a826e162cf9d4ccaa20e02bee6a3389e67bb0/research/owned-canonical-row-producer/CREDITS.md).

The graph embeds all 3,237 instructions of [PR #7735](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7735), with only control-target relocation and halt-to-return jumps. A physical height countdown creates the address field. A binary carry scan supplies `x=0,...,N-1`; the first carry into its high padded bit ends the row. Every output write, bit retirement, address operation and final head return is charged. The same private windows are reused across all calls; clearing does not erase historical cost.

```text
T <= 1024N(h+4) + 80(h+4) + 48N <= 1280N(h+4)
K_after <= K_entry + N + 20(h+4)
```

| Evidence | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Exact source composition | Every retained point instruction, source graph digest and eighteen byte-pinned files |
| Two literal interpreters | All 213 rows and 1,566 bits in 49 complete canonical networks through height 3 |
| Historical workload | All seventeen h=5, s=17, j=6 rows: 544 bits and 1,360,554 transitions |
| Larger complete rows | Six rows through height 12, including the sharp three-rectangle row and a 4,096-bit output |
| Complete return state | All cells, heads, write counts, private-guard lifetimes and historical intervals |
| Controls | Four numeric-domain rejections per interpreter, three output/tail/retirement mutations and two alias rejections |

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/owned-canonical-row-producer
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_OWNED_CANONICAL_ROW_PRODUCER 15 tapes; complete owned rows and returns
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44407064815/job/135165013841) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence. The all-height claim follows from the written address/owner invariant and loop counts. The exact transition counts are service counts, not wall-clock timings or a matched full-caller speedup.

Credit Ali Romman for the retained [linear point service](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa/research/linear-tape-rotation-switch/PROOF.md), Jerry Chen for the [builder, tape ABI and cleanup](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/56335a406469fad85e88ff72820d506d8bea6f63/research/literal-canonical-rotation-switch/PROOF.md), Nick Petalas for the [endpoint formulas](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7efb9a84277ec31abe2a934aeef8c8a70548aa5b/research/canonical-rotation-switch-query/PROOF.md), and Cinna Davis for the [canonical compiler](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a/research/unconditional-batched-crt/check_batched_crt.py). Their source bytes and notices remain intact. The new controller uses the source loader and Tape operations directly; it does not patch their functions or alter the source fourteen-owner CPU.

The [three-rectangle arithmetic stream](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/913d61fd9bd5d3d65a11c04f1baf50fc24ceb858/research/rotation-row-rectangles/PROOF.md) has a sharper output-linear bound. Its direct tape lowering remains open. JoyboyBrian's [PR #5092](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5092) produces all layers and joins a key service; that different workload is not a matched baseline for this row service.

The caller supplies encoded descriptors, disjoint blank windows and framing. The returned row remains owned. Actual CRT descriptor production, encoding conversion, transport, payload consumption and output disposal remain open caller costs. Historical full suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Consumed point head: `460eb0c026649b28ab3b00f45de136599d0570fa`; its exact mathematical and hardware dependencies are retained in the source pins. Row-theorem context: `913d61fd9bd5d3d65a11c04f1baf50fc24ceb858`. No unmerged source ancestry is asserted. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. The two instruction paths share the graph and fixture boundary; no independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19719352).
